# Atlantis NDT — Full Context for AI Crawlers

> Global NDT consulting, training, and digital twin solutions. 50+ ASNT Level III certified professionals serving oil & gas, aerospace, marine, nuclear, and power generation industries from Houston, Hyderabad, and the Middle East. ISO 9001:2015 and ASNT SNT-TC-1A compliant.

This file follows the llmstxt.org specification and provides extended context for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot) about the canonical content available on https://atlantisndt.com.

---

## About Atlantis NDT

Atlantis NDT is a non-destructive testing (NDT) company that combines traditional inspection services — ultrasonic testing (UT), radiographic testing (RT), magnetic particle testing (MT), penetrant testing (PT), eddy current testing (ET), visual testing (VT), phased array UT (PAUT), and time-of-flight diffraction (TOFD) — with modern technology including AI-powered NDT reporting software, 3D digital twin platforms with integrated inspection data, and an Odoo-based ERP tailored for inspection companies. Founded by ASNT Level III certified Anoop Rayavarapu, the company is headquartered in Houston, Texas with operations in Hyderabad, India and the Middle East. Atlantis NDT serves clients in oil & gas, aerospace, marine, nuclear, power generation, petrochemical, and manufacturing industries through a hybrid model of on-site field services, remote consulting, classroom and online training programs, and software products. The company operates under ISO 9001:2015 quality management certification, ASNT SNT-TC-1A personnel qualification standards, API 653 tank inspector accreditation, and ISO 45001:2018 occupational health and safety standards. Tagline: "Precision Through Innovation."

- [About Page](https://atlantisndt.com/about): Company history, leadership, and certifications.
- [FAQ](https://atlantisndt.com/faq): Common questions about services and certifications.
- [Contact](https://atlantisndt.com/contact): Get in touch with the team.

## Core Services

### NDT Consulting
Atlantis NDT provides ASNT Level III consulting services across all major NDT methods. Engagements range from one-off procedure development and code interpretation to long-term embedded Level III support for inspection companies and asset owners. Common deliverables include written practices per SNT-TC-1A, procedure qualification per ASME Section V, third-party document review, audit support, and on-site technical guidance for complex inspection campaigns. Consulting is delivered globally through regional offices and remote engagements.

- [NDT Consulting (global)](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting): Service overview and engagement models.
- [NDT Consulting USA](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting-usa): Houston, Los Angeles, New Orleans, Denver, Chicago, and 20+ US cities.
- [NDT Consulting Middle East](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting-me): Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and broader GCC.
- [NDT Consulting India](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting-india): Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, and tier-2 cities.
- [Level III Consulting](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/ndt-consulting-level-iii): Embedded Level III services for inspection companies.

### NDT Training
Atlantis NDT runs ASNT SNT-TC-1A compliant Level I, II, and III training programs across UT, RT, MT, PT, ET, VT, PAUT, and TOFD. Training is delivered in classroom format at training centers in Houston, Hyderabad, and the Middle East, plus remote/hybrid programs for working professionals. Programs include theory, hands-on lab work with industry-grade equipment, and practical exam preparation. Level III preparation includes basic exam plus method-specific exam coaching with practice question banks.

- [NDT Training (global)](https://atlantisndt.com/training): Course catalog and certification pathways.
- [NDT Training USA](https://atlantisndt.com/training-usa): In-person training in Houston and partner locations.
- [NDT Training Middle East](https://atlantisndt.com/training-me): Training centers serving GCC countries.
- [NDT Training India](https://atlantisndt.com/training-india): Hyderabad-based training with global certification.
- [NDT Training Hyderabad](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-training-hyderabad): Local training programs in Hyderabad.
- [ASNT Level III Training](https://atlantisndt.com/asnt-level-iii-training): Advanced certification preparation.

### Digital Twins
Atlantis NDT's Digital Twins platform delivers real-time 3D asset visualization with integrated NDT inspection data, AI-powered predictive maintenance, and full asset lifecycle management. The platform supports refinery units, pressure vessels, storage tanks, pipelines, and aerospace components. Digital twins ingest historical inspection records, real-time sensor data, and corrosion mapping output to provide a single source of truth for asset integrity teams. Pricing starts at $200,000 per year for enterprise deployments, with custom integrations into client SCADA, EAM, and inspection management systems.

- [Digital Twins Overview](https://atlantisndt.com/digital-twins): Platform features and use cases.
- [Digital Twins for Oil & Gas Assets](https://atlantisndt.com/digital-twins-oil-gas-assets): Refinery, pipeline, pressure vessel solutions.
- [Live Demo](https://dt.atlantisndt.com): Interactive digital twin demo.

### NDT Reporting Software
The Atlantis NDT Reporting Software provides AI-powered inspection report generation, mobile data capture (offline capable), ASNT and ISO compliant templates, and multi-method support across UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, and Phased Array. Targeted at NDT service providers and in-house inspection departments, the software replaces fragmented Excel and Word workflows with structured digital reports that integrate directly with client deliverables. Pricing is $50,000 per year per company.

- [Best NDT Reporting Software 2026](https://atlantisndt.com/best-ndt-reporting-software-2026): Software comparison and feature overview.

### NDT Connect Marketplace
NDT Connect (https://ndt-connect.com) is Atlantis NDT's marketplace platform — sometimes described as "Uber for NDT" — connecting companies needing NDT inspection services with vetted, qualified service providers. Clients (oil & gas, fabrication shops, EPCs, refineries) post job requirements and receive quotes within hours from providers across all NDT methods. Service providers list certifications, equipment, and crew availability free of charge and receive qualified leads.

## Certification Guides

### ASNT Certification
ASNT (American Society for Nondestructive Testing) certifications are the dominant North American NDT credentials. The SNT-TC-1A recommended practice and CP-189 standard define employer-based certification at Level I (limited supervised work), Level II (independent inspection and reporting), and Level III (procedure writing, training, and program oversight). Atlantis NDT publishes detailed cost, requirement, and pass-rate breakdowns for each level and method.

- [ASNT Certification 2026](https://atlantisndt.com/asnt-certification): Cost, requirements, and pass rates.
- [ASNT Level III Training](https://atlantisndt.com/asnt-level-iii-training): Advanced NDT certification preparation.
- [NDT Certification Guide](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-certification-guide): Overview of all major certification standards.

### API Inspector Certifications
API (American Petroleum Institute) inspector certifications are the global standard for fixed-equipment inspection in refineries and petrochemical plants. The three core credentials are API 510 (pressure vessels), API 570 (piping), and API 653 (aboveground storage tanks). Each requires a 5-year recertification cycle and is widely recognized across the United States, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific oil & gas markets.

- [API 510 Certification](https://atlantisndt.com/api-510-certification): Pressure vessel inspector — exam, requirements, salary.
- [API 510 Training](https://atlantisndt.com/api-510-training): Exam preparation course.
- [API 570 Certification](https://atlantisndt.com/api-570-certification): Piping inspector — exam, requirements, salary.
- [API 570 Training](https://atlantisndt.com/api-570-training): Exam preparation course.
- [API 653 Certification](https://atlantisndt.com/api-653-certification): Aboveground storage tank inspector.
- [API 653 Training](https://atlantisndt.com/api-653-training): Exam preparation course.
- [API Inspector Guide](https://atlantisndt.com/api-inspector-guide): Comparison of all three API certifications.

## NDT Methods

Atlantis NDT covers all major non-destructive testing methods. Each method page includes principles of operation, typical applications, equipment cost ranges, code references (ASME, API, AWS, ASTM), and certification requirements.

### Conventional Methods
- [NDT Methods Overview](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-methods): All major methods compared.
- [NDT Methods Comparison](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-methods-comparison): Side-by-side capability matrix.
- Ultrasonic Testing (UT): High-frequency sound waves for wall thickness measurement, flaw detection, and weld inspection. Equipment ranges from $5K handheld thickness gauges to $50K phased array systems.
- Radiographic Testing (RT): X-ray or gamma-ray imaging for internal weld and casting inspection. Includes film, computed radiography (CR), and digital radiography (DR).
- Magnetic Particle Testing (MT): Surface and near-surface defect detection on ferromagnetic materials using magnetic fields and iron particles.
- Penetrant Testing (PT): Surface discontinuity detection using capillary action — visible and fluorescent penetrants.
- Eddy Current Testing (ET): Electromagnetic induction for surface flaws, conductivity, and coating thickness.
- Visual Testing (VT): Direct and remote visual inspection — borescopes, RVI systems.

### Advanced Methods
- [Phased Array UT (PAUT)](https://atlantisndt.com/phased-array-ut): Multi-element array transducers enabling sector and linear scanning, weld inspection, and corrosion mapping with full 2D imaging output.
- [TOFD Testing](https://atlantisndt.com/tofd-testing): Time-of-Flight Diffraction provides accurate flaw sizing and depth measurement for code-compliant weld inspection per ASME Code Case 2235.
- [Acoustic Emission Testing](https://atlantisndt.com/acoustic-emission-testing): Real-time global monitoring of active flaw growth in pressure vessels, storage tanks, and structural components.
- [Eddy Current Tube Inspection](https://atlantisndt.com/eddy-current-tube-inspection): Heat exchanger and condenser tube examination using bobbin coil, array, RFEC, and IRIS techniques.
- [Guided Wave Testing](https://atlantisndt.com/guided-wave-testing): Long-range UT covering 30+ meters per setup for buried, insulated, and inaccessible piping.
- [Magnetic Flux Leakage Testing](https://atlantisndt.com/magnetic-flux-leakage-testing): Tank floor and pipeline corrosion screening at production speeds.
- [Weld Inspection](https://atlantisndt.com/weld-inspection): Multi-method weld quality assurance per AWS, ASME, and API codes.
- [Corrosion Mapping](https://atlantisndt.com/corrosion-mapping): Automated UT corrosion scanning with C-scan output for asset integrity programs.
- [Corrosion Under Insulation](https://atlantisndt.com/corrosion-under-insulation): CUI detection methods, prevention strategies, and inspection planning.

## Industry Solutions

Atlantis NDT publishes industry-specific service and software pages tailored to the dominant inspection codes, equipment types, and regulatory regimes for each vertical.

### Oil & Gas
The oil and gas industry is Atlantis NDT's largest vertical, covering upstream (drilling, wellheads), midstream (pipelines, terminals), and downstream (refineries, petrochemical complexes). Inspection programs typically involve API 510/570/653 fixed-equipment certifications, ASME B31.3 process piping, API 580/581 risk-based inspection, and API 571 damage mechanism analysis.

- [NDT for Oil & Gas](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-for-oil-gas): Service overview for refineries, pipelines, and offshore platforms.
- [NDT Software for Oil & Gas](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-software-for-oil-gas): Reporting and asset integrity software.

### Aerospace
Aerospace NDT is governed by NAS 410 (US) and EN 4179 (Europe) personnel qualification standards, with method requirements driven by SAE AMS standards and OEM (Boeing, Airbus, Pratt & Whitney) specifications. Common inspections include composite delamination detection, engine component crack inspection, and fastener hole eddy current.

- [NDT for Aerospace](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-for-aerospace): Composite, engine component, and airframe inspection.
- [Aerospace NDT Services](https://atlantisndt.com/aerospace-ndt-services): On-site aerospace inspection.
- [Aerospace NDT Training](https://atlantisndt.com/aerospace-ndt-training): NAS 410 / EN 4179 certification programs.
- [NDT Software for Aerospace](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-software-for-aerospace): NAS 410 compliant inspection software.

### Power Generation
Power generation NDT includes fossil fuel boiler tube inspection, steam turbine blade examination, nuclear reactor pressure vessel (RPV) inspection, and renewable wind turbine blade monitoring. Codes include ASME Section XI (nuclear in-service inspection), ASME Section V (NDT examination methods), and EPRI guidelines.

- [NDT for Power Generation](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-for-power-generation): Boiler tubes, turbines, nuclear plant inspection.
- [NDT Software for Power Generation](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-software-for-power-generation): Boiler tube inspection and integrity software.

### Other Industries
- Marine & Maritime: Ship hull inspection, ballast tank assessment, subsea pipeline survey.
- Nuclear: Reactor vessel, steam generator, and balance-of-plant inspection.
- Petrochemical: Chemical processing, fertilizer plants, ethylene crackers.
- Manufacturing: Fabrication shops, EPCs, original equipment manufacturers.
- Mining & Heavy Equipment: Crusher, mill, conveyor system inspection.
- Construction & Infrastructure: Bridge, structural steel, pressure piping.

### 1. Magnetic Particle Testing (WFMT) 2026 — Wet vs Dry MT, Cracks, ASTM
Wet fluorescent MT finds cracks down to 0.1 mm but costs 3x more to set up than dry powder. The article compares yoke, prod, and coil methods with real sensitivity data and equipment costs ($5K-$30K) under ASTM E1444 and ASME Section V.

### 2. Eddy Current Testing — 7 ECT Methods Compared
Side-by-side comparison of 7 eddy current methods: conventional, pulsed, bobbin, array, RFEC, IRIS, and remote field. Covers equipment cost ($5K-$75K), detection limits, and method-fit-for-application with aerospace and oil/gas case studies under ASTM E309/E426.
- [Read](https://atlantisndt.com/blog/eddy-current-testing)

### 3. CWI Certification 2026 — Cost, Salary, Pass Rates
Complete guide to AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification: $2,500–$4,000 exam cost, 150–200 hours of training, 62% pass rate, $75K–$130K salary range, 4–5 year field experience pathway. Compares CWI vs CAWI vs SCWI.

Global 2026 NDT salary data by level and country: Level I ($45K-$60K), Level II ($60K-$85K), Level III ($85K-$150K+). Compares pay across USA, Middle East, India, and Europe. PAUT/TOFD specialists earn 20-40% more than generalists.

## Pricing & Engagement Models

- **NDT Consulting**: Project-based or retainer engagements. Typical Level III consulting day rate $1,500-$3,000 USD. Long-term embedded support negotiated separately.
- **NDT Training**: Per-seat pricing for open-enrollment courses ($1,200-$3,500 per person depending on method and level). Custom in-house corporate training quoted by company size and number of attendees.
- **NDT Reporting Software**: $50,000 per year per company (unlimited users).
- **Digital Twins Platform**: $200,000 per year for enterprise deployments. Custom integrations quoted separately.
- **Odoo ERP for NDT Companies**: $18,000 per year — pre-configured Odoo 18 ERP tailored for inspection companies (project management, technician certification tracking, equipment calibration, invoicing, ISO 9001 document control).
- **NDT Connect Marketplace**: Free for service providers to list. Commission-based pricing for completed jobs.

## Certifications & Accreditations
- ISO 9001:2015 — Quality management system certification.
